required_assumptions: f is a unary function symbol
hypotheses.scientific_rationale: The catalog entries are the zero-order evaluations f(x), f(y) and the first divided difference of the same unary function f. A single latent function F(z)=f(z), with substitutions at x and y and the first Newton divided difference at (x, y), reconstructs all non-identical members without simplifying the original expression.
